name: Tuner
description: Free TV with an old-school look: Pluto TV, Samsung TV Plus and iptv-org channels plus your own M3U playlists and Xtream accounts, a TV guide, favourites, search, hardware video decoding, and VCR and Teletext looks.
author: evolver79

changelog.v1.1.0: Two looks, redone: VCR (an on-screen display over the picture, tape winding and tracking noise) and Teletext (pages that are searched for and arrive, a block-graphics masthead, a listings guide). Hardware video decoding (H.264/H.265) on the Brick's video engine. Stats for nerds (SELECT). Audio tracks: the one in your language, LEFT/RIGHT to switch, remembered per channel. Max quality also picks the stream's quality. Big provider guides read correctly and kept for a day. START or B on the front page: back to the channel. The volume shown when it changes. Smoother 50 fps channels, and fixes.
